hooks.command: jq -r '[.cwd, (.last_assistant_message // "")] | @tsv' | { IFS=$'\t' read -r cwd msg; dir=$(basename "$cwd"); snippet=$(echo "$msg" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-100); notify-send -t 20000 "Claude Code — $dir" "$snippet" 2>/dev/null; canberra-gtk-play -i complete 2>/dev/null || paplay /usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/complete.oga 2>/dev/null; } || true
